posts.title: Open course dates for November
posts.excerpt: Open courses at the Rotterdam centre are bookable for individual places every Tuesday in November.
posts.content:
Emergency First Aid at Work runs every Tuesday at the centre on Werfstraat, 08:30 to 16:30, with lunch from 12:30 to 13:15. The fee is €145 per person excl. VAT, and a course takes at most twelve trainees.

The three-day First Aid at Work course runs Monday to Wednesday in the first and third week of the month at €395. CPR & AED Operator is a half day on the second and fourth Thursday, 13:00–16:30, at €85.

Certificates are issued the same day and are valid for three years. Group bookings are handled separately; write to hello@kyugotraining.example.

posts.title: What’s new in this year’s Annual Refresher
posts.excerpt: The refresher syllabus was reviewed in January against current published resuscitation guidelines.
posts.content:
Every January we read the current published resuscitation guidelines against our syllabus and change what needs changing. This year the refresher spends more of its three hours on compression rhythm and AED pad placement and less on lecture.

The Annual Refresher runs on the second and fourth Thursday, 08:30–11:30, for €75 per person excl. VAT. Bring your previous certificate; we send a reminder ninety days before it expires.

posts.title: Planning first-aid cover for night shifts
posts.excerpt: A short guide for employers who run rotating or overnight teams.
posts.content:
A day course on Tuesday does not help a team that works nights. For industrial employers we run closed group days at your premises, up to twelve trainees at €1,480 per group, with the kit and mannequins included.

Book at least three weeks ahead. After a 30-minute planning call about your shift patterns and typical risks, we fix the dates and send the register to the employer on the training day.

posts.title: Where to put an AED on a warehouse floor
posts.excerpt: Three questions we ask on every site visit before a group day.
posts.content:
Can a colleague reach it from the far end of the aisle in under a minute? Is it on a route a person would run without thinking? Can everyone on the shift say where it is?

During a scenario in the mock aisle we time the walk, the call and the handover to the ambulance crew. The answers are usually simpler than the equipment.

posts.title: Our new scenario room: the mock kitchen
posts.excerpt: The hall now has a mock kitchen next to the warehouse aisle and the mock office.
posts.content:
Burns and chemical splashes happen in kitchens, so our 220 m² hall now has a full mock kitchen with a steel counter, a hob and a sink. Pieter Aalders builds the incidents and plays the casualty.

The kitchen is used in the Burns & Chemical Splash module, a half day on the last Friday of the month, 08:30–12:00, for €95 per person excl. VAT.

posts.title: How to prepare staff for their first course day
posts.excerpt: Plain advice for the people you are sending to us.
posts.content:
Wear clothes you can kneel in and flat shoes. You will spend five of the seven hours on the floor, so comfortable matters more than smart.

Bring a lunch or use the break from 12:30 to 13:15. You do not need to revise: the day starts with hands, not slides, and the assessment is a practical check plus ten short written questions.
